# MHB Build, LLC

> General contractor based in Independence, Kentucky. Serves residential and small-scale construction across Northern Kentucky. Services include general contracting, home building, home improvements, roofing, carpentry, decorative moldings, exterior painting, concrete flatwork, flooring installation, and tile installation.
